verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ

trs.20: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197344>1</sup>
trs.85: Ha Mim
trs.22: Ha-Mim.
trs.203: Hâ.-Mîm.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

trs.20: By the clear Book,
trs.85: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
trs.22: By the Book that makes things clear;-
trs.203: By the manifest Book (this Qur’ân) that makes things clear.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.<sup foot_note=197345>1</sup> Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
trs.85: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
trs.22: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
trs.203: We sent it (this Qur’ân) down on a blessed night [(i.e. night of Al-Qadr, Sûrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadân - the 9th month of the Islâmic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship].

verses.text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

trs.20: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct<sup foot_note=197346>1</sup> every precise matter -
trs.85: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
trs.22: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
trs.203: Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments.<sup foot_note=154896>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

trs.20: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
trs.85: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
trs.22: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
trs.203: As a Command (or this Qur’ân or the Decree of every matter) from Us. Verily, We are ever sending (the Messengers),

verses.text_uthmani: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
trs.85: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
trs.22: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
trs.203: (As) a Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

trs.20: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
trs.85: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
trs.22: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
trs.203: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty.

verses.text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

trs.20: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
trs.85: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
trs.22: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
trs.203: Lâ ilaha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). It is He Who gives life and causes death - your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ

trs.20: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
trs.85: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
trs.22: Yet they play about in doubt.
trs.203: Nay! They play about in doubt.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
trs.85: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
trs.22: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
trs.203: Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

trs.20: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
trs.85: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
trs.22: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
trs.203: Covering the people: this is a painful torment.

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
trs.85: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
trs.22: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
trs.203: (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"

verses.text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
trs.85: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
trs.22: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
trs.203: How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ

trs.20: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
trs.85: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
trs.22: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
trs.203: Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and said: (He is) one taught (by a human being), a madman!"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
trs.85: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
trs.22: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
trs.203: Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert (to disbelief).

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

trs.20: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
trs.85: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
trs.22: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
trs.203: On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure (punishment). Verily, We will exact retribution.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ

trs.20: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
trs.85: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
trs.22: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
trs.203: And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people, when there came to them a noble Messenger [i.e. Mûsâ (Moses) عليه السلام],

verses.text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ

trs.20: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.<sup foot_note=197347>1</sup> Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
trs.85: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
trs.22: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
trs.203: Saying: "Deliver to me the slaves of Allâh (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
trs.85: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
trs.22: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
trs.203: "And exalt not yourselves against Allâh. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

trs.20: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.<sup foot_note=197348>1</sup>
trs.85: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
trs.22: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
trs.203: "And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me (or call me a sorcerer or kill me).

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

trs.20: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
trs.85: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
trs.22: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
trs.203: "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ

trs.20: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
trs.85: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
trs.22: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
trs.203: (But they were aggressive), so he [Mûsâ (Moses)] called upon his Lord (saying): "These are indeed the people who are Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

trs.20: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
trs.85: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
trs.22: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
trs.203: (Allâh said): "Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ

trs.20: And leave the sea in stillness.<sup foot_note=197349>1</sup> Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
trs.85: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
trs.22: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
trs.203: "And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned."

verses.text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

trs.20: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
trs.85: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
trs.22: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
trs.203: How many of gardens and springs that they [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people] left behind,

verses.text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ

trs.20: And crops and noble sites
trs.85: many a cornfield and noble building,
trs.22: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
trs.203: And green crops (fields) and goodly places,

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ

trs.20: And comfort wherein they were amused.
trs.85: many a thing in which they had delighted:
trs.22: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
trs.203: And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

trs.20: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
trs.85: We gave these to another people to inherit.
trs.22: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
trs.203: Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them (i.e. We made the Children of Israel to inherit the kingdom of Egypt).

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

trs.20: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
trs.85: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
trs.22: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
trs.203: And the heavens and the earth wept not for them,<sup foot_note=154897>1</sup> nor were they given a respite.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

trs.20: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
trs.85: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
trs.22: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
trs.203: And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment:

verses.text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

trs.20: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
trs.85: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
trs.22: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
trs.203: From Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he was arrogant and was of the Musrifûn (those who transgress beyond bound in spending and other things and commit great sins).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
trs.85: We chose them knowingly above others:
trs.22: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
trs.203: And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn) [during the time of Mûsâ (Moses)] with knowledge,

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
trs.85: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
trs.22: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
trs.203: And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
trs.85: These people here assert,
trs.22: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
trs.203: Verily, these (Quraish) people are saying:

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

trs.20: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
trs.85: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
trs.22: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
trs.203: "There is nothing but our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
trs.85: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
trs.22: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
trs.203: "Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!"

verses.text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

trs.20: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ<sup foot_note=197350>1</sup> and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
trs.85: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
trs.22: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
trs.203: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were indeed Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

trs.20: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
trs.85: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
trs.22: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
trs.203: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
trs.85: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
trs.22: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
trs.203: We created them not except with truth (i.e. to examine and test those who are obedient and those who are disobedient and then reward the obedient ones and punish the disobedient ones), but most of them know not.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
trs.85: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
trs.22: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
trs.203: Verily, the Day of Judgement (when Allâh will judge between the creatures) is the time appointed for all of them -

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

trs.20: The Day when no relation<sup foot_note=197351>1</sup> will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
trs.85: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
trs.22: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
trs.203: The Day when a Maulâ (a near relative) cannot avail a Maulâ (a near relative) in aught, and no help can they receive,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

trs.20: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
trs.85: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
trs.22: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: Except him on whom Allâh has Mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

trs.20: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
trs.85: The tree of Zaqqum
trs.22: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
trs.203: Verily, the tree of Zaqqûm

verses.text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

trs.20: Is food for the sinful.
trs.85: will be food for the sinners:
trs.22: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
trs.203: Will be the food of the sinners.

verses.text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

trs.20: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
trs.85: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
trs.22: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
trs.203: Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,

verses.text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

trs.20: Like the boiling of scalding water.
trs.85: like seething water.
trs.22: Like the boiling of scalding water.
trs.203: Like the boiling of scalding water.

verses.text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

trs.20: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
trs.85: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
trs.22: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
trs.203: (It will be said) "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire,

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

trs.20: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
trs.85: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
trs.22: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
trs.203: "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water.

verses.text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

trs.20: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!<sup foot_note=197352>1</sup>
trs.85: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!
trs.22: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
trs.203: "Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
trs.85: This is what you doubted.’
trs.22: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
trs.203: "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt!"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
trs.85: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
trs.22: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
trs.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), will be in place of Security (Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

trs.20: Within gardens and springs,
trs.85: amid Gardens and springs,
trs.22: Among Gardens and Springs;
trs.203: Among Gardens and Springs,

verses.text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ

trs.20: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
trs.85: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
trs.22: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
trs.203: Dressed in fine silk and (also) in thick silk, facing each other,

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ

trs.20: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
trs.85: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
trs.22: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
trs.203: So (it will be). And We shall marry them to Hûr<sup foot_note=154898>1</sup> (fair female) with wide, lovely eyes.

verses.text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

trs.20: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
trs.85: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
trs.22: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
trs.203: They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security;

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

trs.20: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
trs.85: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
trs.22: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
trs.203: They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,

verses.text_uthmani: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

trs.20: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
trs.85: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
trs.22: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
trs.203: As a Bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success!

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
trs.85: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
trs.22: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
trs.203: Certainly, We have made this (Qur’an) easy in your tongue, in order that they may remember.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ

trs.20: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
trs.85: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
trs.22: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
trs.203: Wait then (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم); verily, they (too) are waiting.
